docs/release/producer-release-policy.jso.template: Consumer admission is projected from docs/release/runtime-policy.json into package.json engines.node, with declared minimums of Node {{runtime:minimums}} within those majors. Freeze the minimum, latest released patch and distinct reference for each policy family once per hosted qualification; require the same retained-tarball scoped/alias consumer contracts on every declared platform and product source behavior on Linux. Producer tools use exact reference runtimes {{runtime:referenceRange}} and npm {{runtime:npm}}; consumer qualification uses separately admitted npm {{runtime:consumerNpm}}. Each report binds actual Node/npm, OS/architecture, source, run/attempt, matrix digest and candidate bytes. These minimums await actual passing installed-package and native-platform evidence; tests and workflow dispatches remain deferred for this change. Preserve Node {{runtime:canonicalNode}} canonical production and Markdown/Java authority and upstream-support distinctions.

All registry development declarations use stable >= minimums; the exact qualified graph, integrity, authenticated legal evidence and install-script decisions remain locked and reviewed. Local npm eligibility is {{runtime:npmRange}} with versionless devEngines.runtime; producer CI, release and governed verification bootstrap exact npm {{runtime:npm}} before project commands or cache probes. Consumer lanes retain producer-installed tools, then select the frozen Node and separately admitted npm {{runtime:consumerNpm}} without installing the development graph at consumer floors. Preserve production pins, canonical Node {{runtime:canonicalNode}}, denied scripts, Markdown file archives/lock, Python and Actions pins. Deliberate resolution and frozen npm ci are distinct operations.
